why:
non-blocking read of one feedback message from the client's feedback channel, for code that owns its loop rather than installing a callback (RFC-0022's polling shape, offered on the callback tier too). rclcpp_action delivers feedback ONLY through `SendGoalOptions::feedback_callback`. Pairs with `c:action_client_try_recv_feedback`.

phase-428 (RFC-0089): re-keyed by the namespace flip. `nros::ActionClient<A>` / `nros::ActionServer<A>` are now aliases of `rclcpp_action::Client<A>` / `rclcpp_action::Server<A>`, which the extractor keys as `Client::*` / `Server::*`. The type is `same` now and the member is `ours-only`, so it no longer inherits its type's verdict and carries its own.
